messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: error-rate spike for customer Zephyr (vpc-dedicated-pool-11). 5xx on tool-call handler (jsonpath parser). 90% of tool-calls failing since 12:04 UTC. Pager routed to eng-oncall.
Sasha L: on it. pulling logs + customer impact. @Jordan (cust-eng) can you confirm customer noticing? any active deploys on their side?
Jordan (cust-eng): they started a config rollout at ~11:58 but reporting errors to support. Customer says 'functions returning parse error: path $.payment.amount not found'.
Miguel P: seeing stacktrace in runtime: ```2026-03-15T12:03:58Z handler.go:234 jsonpath: key error: 'payment.amount' not found
stack: github.com/redwood/runtime/tooling/parse.go:112
``` looks like schema drift in their tool output. Only Zephyr tenant hitting this; deduped to dedicated pool instance group id=dp-11.
Olivia R: confirming isolation: dp-11 hosts only zephyr and a staging job. No other tenants affected. Good. Initial mitigation options: 1) route Zephyr to a compatibility parser (legacy lenient jsonpath), 2) short rollback of parser change on dp-11, 3) throttle/ingress to reduce error flood and give customer time.
Sasha L: prioritize fast mitigation that doesn't require customer code change. Miguel, can we flip to legacy parser in runtime config for dp-11? impact: slightly higher CPU but immediate.
Miguel P: yes. There is a feature-flag `runtime.parser.strict_jsonpath=true|false`. I can toggle via infra API. Will run a canary on one node then cascade. Doing now: `curl -XPOST https://control.internal/v1/pools/dp-11/flags -d '{"strict_jsonpath":false}'` (will attach logs)
DeployBot: Deploy started by Miguel P - change strict_jsonpath=false on dp-11. Job id: deploy-7621.
Miguel P: canary applied to node dp-11-a. Observing logs... initial toolcalls succeed. 200 -> 95% success on canary.
Sasha L: good. roll to rest of pool with 30s stagger.
DeployBot: Rollout 30s stagger -> dp-11-b -> dp-11-c -> dp-11-d completed. All nodes show success rates > 93%.
Jordan (cust-eng): customer support confirms errors cleared for most traffic, they see reduced error messages. They will halt their config rollout and validate mapping changes.
Sasha L: note: mitigation preserves availability but tolerates looser jsonpath semantics. Need postmortem + rollback plan to re-enable strict after customer updates.
Miguel P: root cause: upstream SDK changed payload: `payment` node moved under `transaction` in a subset of requests, causing strict parser to throw. We had a recent parser refactor deployed yesterday that added strict lookups. Repro locally with sample payload from Zephyr.
Olivia R: impact: customer-facing errors ~6k requests/min failing over 20 minutes, estimated 120k failed tool-calls. Only Zephyr affected because of dedicated pool filtering.
Sasha L: paging note: oncall handoff in ~2h. Ryan K will take over. @Ryan K FYI, I will annotate runbook and leave ops steps in thread.
Ryan K: ack. I’ll be on standby for the handoff.
Sasha L: ops steps (will keep short):
1) If error-rate spikes again, toggle `strict_jsonpath=false` on pool dp-11 via control API (curl above).
2) If toggle fails, set pool dp-11 to maintenance routing and move traffic to dp-legacy via `control route` (we have capacity reserved for critical tenants).
3) Collect full set of failing payloads: `kubectl logs -lpool=dp-11 -ctooling | grep jsonpath` -> upload to secure bucket `s3://incidents/zephyr/1812349999`
Miguel P: attaching quick diff to revert refactor: `git rev-parse HEAD~1` -> patch ready. Will open PR for review. If needed we can hotfix to master and cut patch release.
Jordan (cust-eng): I've asked Zephyr to pause rollout and share sample payloads. they sent 3 example payloads; uploaded to the secure bucket.
Sasha L: customer impact update: Zephyr confirms 98% traffic healthy after rollout; support queue cleared to 2 open tickets. Good.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Severity-2 -> Degraded (partial customer impact mitigated). Incident channel: #incidents/zephyr-1812349999 created.
Miguel P: next steps: 1) coordinate with Zephyr to update their mapping (move `payment` -> `transaction.payment`) or add compatibility shim on their SDK, 2) schedule parser refactor rollback or make strict mode opt-in per-tenant, 3) postmortem doc.
Sasha L: trying to avoid global rollback. Plan: keep legacy parser for dp-11 for 24h while Zephyr validates. Add a tenant-scoped flag support in next sprint.
Jordan (cust-eng): customer prefers internal fix on their side; will aim to ship mapping fix in 48h. They asked us to keep legacy parser for now.
Olivia R: monitoring: added latency & error dashboards for dp-11 and a synthetic check every 30s for typical toolcall schema. Alert threshold: >3% 5xx over 5m.
Sasha L: handoff to Ryan: I’ll leave the oncall pager pinned. Ryan, you have the runway: if any regression occurs, follow ops steps and escalate to Eng-Infra.
Ryan K: taking over. Notes copied. Will keep thread live. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Sasha L: resolved for now. will follow up with postmortem template and timeline. tagging for post-incident review: @olivia, @miguel, @jordan (cust-eng).
